share.seoTitle: Share Files via a Temporary Download Link
share.seoDescription: Upload up to 500 MB and get a time-limited link. Optional password and download cap; once expired, the file can't be accessed and is deleted.
share.downloadSeoDescription: Download a file shared temporarily via PikaEdit. The link contains a random ID; the uploader may have set an optional password.
share.title: Share a File
share.description: Upload a file and get a shareable link. The file is stored on our server; once it expires, it can no longer be accessed and is deleted from the server.
share.serverNotice: This tool uploads your file to our server. The file is stored unencrypted on the server's disk for the period you choose (up to 7 days); the password only restricts downloading. As soon as it expires the file can no longer be accessed; it is deleted from the server by the automatic cleanup that runs every 5 minutes.
share.dropzoneHint: Click to browse — up to 500 MB — no .exe, .bat, .sh or similar
share.readyDesc: Share the link below. Once it expires, the link stops working and the file is deleted from the server.
share.errorBlockedType: This file type is not allowed for security reasons.
share.errorNetwork: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
share.fileNotFoundDesc: This link is invalid or the file has already been deleted.
share.fileExpiredDesc: The link has expired and the file has been permanently deleted.
share.limitReachedDesc: This file has reached its maximum number of downloads and has been deleted.
share.serverError: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
share.downloadCompleteDesc: Your download has started. Check your downloads folder.
share.faq1a: Files are stored for the period you choose — 30 minutes to 7 days, counted from the end of the upload. As soon as a file expires it can no longer be accessed; it is deleted from the server by the automatic cleanup that runs every 5 minutes.
share.faq2a: The file is stored unencrypted on our server's disk. The link contains an 8-character random ID and there is no page that lists files. Anyone with the link can see the file name and size; if you set a password, the file itself cannot be downloaded without it.
share.faq3a: All file types are allowed except executables and scripts (.exe, .bat, .sh, .msi, .cmd, .scr, .ps1, .vbs, .js, .jar, .com, .pif). Maximum file size is 500 MB.
share.protectedFileDesc: The file name, size and download details are only shared once the correct password is entered.
share.passwordRequired: A password is required to download this file.
share.tooManyPasswordAttempts: Too many incorrect passwords. Please try again later.

url-shortener.title: URL Shortener
url-shortener.description: Shorten long URLs and share them as pikaedit.com/go/... links
url-shortener.seoTitle: Shorten Any URL, Get a QR Code
url-shortener.seoDescription: Paste a long link, get a pikaedit.com/go/... short URL and download a QR code for it.
url-shortener.serverNotice: Short links and the URL you enter are stored on our server. If you choose an expiry, the link stops working as soon as it expires and the record is deleted by the automatic cleanup that runs every 5 minutes; links set to “Never” are not deleted.
url-shortener.errorInvalidUrl: Please enter a valid URL (must start with http:// or https://)
url-shortener.errorRateLimit: Too many requests. Please wait a while.
url-shortener.errorNotFound: This short link was not found or has expired.
url-shortener.step1: Paste your long URL into the input field
url-shortener.step2: Optionally choose an expiry period (7 days, 30 days, 1 year, or never)
url-shortener.step3: Click Shorten, then copy the short link or download the QR code
url-shortener.faq1q: How long are short links valid?
url-shortener.faq1a: Depending on your choice: 7 days, 30 days, 1 year, or indefinitely.
url-shortener.faq2q: Can I delete a short link later?
url-shortener.faq2a: No, there is currently no way to delete a short link manually. If you chose an expiry, the link stops working once it expires; links set to “Never” are not deleted.
url-shortener.faq3a: Yes, completely free and no sign-up required.

meta.siteDescription: Free online tools for PDF, images, video and developers. Most tools process your files right in your browser; tools that use our server are labelled.

serverProcessing.share: This tool uploads your file to our server and stores it unencrypted for the period you choose (up to 7 days). As soon as it expires the file can no longer be accessed; it is deleted from the server by the automatic cleanup that runs every 5 minutes.
serverProcessing.shortener: This tool stores the URL you enter on our server. If you choose an expiry, the link stops working as soon as it expires and the record is deleted by the automatic cleanup that runs every 5 minutes; with “Never” it is not deleted.
